legacy.text: Skip to main content CrowAgent Products Pricing Blog FAQ About ⌘K Sign in Request access COMPARE › CROWMARK VS AUTOGENAI HONEST COMPARISON CrowMark vs AutogenAI An SME bid suite with published pricing set against an enterprise AI bid-writing engine. What each one does, where each one wins, and every competitor figure sourced. Updated 26 July 2026 CrowMark is a UK bid and tender management suite for public-sector suppliers, priced from £49 per month. AutogenAI is an enterprise AI bid-writing engine sold on request to bid teams of five or more. They aim at different buyers. This page compares them feature by feature, states CrowMark's prices, marks any figure AutogenAI does not publish as Not published, and lists every source with a date. At a glance CrowMark compared with AutogenAI across category, features and pricing FEATURE CROWMARK AUTOGENAI Category UK bid and tender management suite Enterprise AI bid-writing engine UK tender discovery (Contracts Finder + Find a Tender) Yes, refreshed daily at 06:00 Not built in; bring your own pipeline Drafting grounded in your own answer library Yes Yes, retrieval over your content library Figure-grounding (AI blocked from inventing a number) Yes, deterministic gate Not stated publicly PPN 017 AI-use disclosure on every draft Yes Not stated publicly PPN 002 social value calculation (10% floor) Yes, deterministic General engine, not a dedicated calculator Post-award delivery evidence (Procurement Act 2023 s.52 / s.71) Yes Procurement Act 2023 alignment stated Published price Yes No Starting price £49/month Not published (enterprise, quote on request) Best for UK SMEs and public-sector suppliers Enterprise bid teams of 5+ What is AutogenAI? AutogenAI is an AI bid-writing engine that generates and reviews proposal content using retrieval over a content library the customer builds from its own past bids. Independent listings describe it as pitched at enterprise bid teams of five or more, sector-agnostic, with an automated compliance review and stated alignment to the Procurement Act 2023. It does not include a UK tender discovery feed; customers bring their own pipeline. AutogenAI is a well-funded, enterprise-scale company. It raised a $39.5m Series B in December 2023, led by Salesforce Ventures and Spark Capital, taking total investment to $65.3m at the time. If you run a large, multi-sector bid team and want a mature engine with a big content library, that scale is a genuine strength, and it is one CrowMark does not match today. AutogenAI does not publish a price. Its pricing is enterprise, quoted on request, so any specific figure you see quoted elsewhere is a third-party estimate rather than a vendor rate. On this page we mark it as Not published. What is CrowMark? CrowMark is CrowAgent's UK bid and tender management suite. It tracks Contracts Finder and Find a Tender, drafts answers cited to the regulations, to the tender's own clauses and to the supplier's answer library, and calculates PPN 002 social value in code. Its defining rule is figure-grounding: before a draft is shown, every £ and % in the prose is checked against a set of allowed figures computed from your own data, and if a number is not in that set the draft is rejected. Every AI-assisted draft also carries a PPN 017 AI-use disclosure and waits for a person to approve it. Tender questions on a contract in CrowMark, shown with a sample account. The panel at the top is the product’s own standing notice about what a draft may be grounded in and who has to approve it. After award, CrowMark keeps the commitment you bid attached to the contract: delivery percentages with a RAG status, evidence capture, monthly social-value reports, and checks against the Procurement Act 2023 KPI duties in sections 52 and 71. It is built for the supplier side of UK public-sector procurement, not for enterprise-wide proposal automation across every sector. CrowMark publishes its pricing. Starter is £49 per month for 3 users, Pro is £149 per month for 10 users with post-award delivery tracking, and Portfolio is contact sales. Every plan includes a 14-day free trial. Pricing compared This is the clearest difference between the two. CrowMark states its numbers in public: £49 and £149 per month, with a free trial and no sales call required to see them. AutogenAI publishes no price and sells through a quote-on-request enterprise process. For a small supplier that wants to know the cost before committing time, published pricing matters, and CrowMark gives it. For an enterprise procurement team used to negotiated contracts, a quote-based model is normal and AutogenAI's scale may justify it. Which should you choose? Choose AutogenAI if You run an enterprise bid team of five or more across multiple sectors. You want a mature, venture-backed engine with a large content library. You are comfortable with enterprise, quote-on-request pricing. You already have your own tender pipeline and do not need UK discovery built in. Choose CrowAgent (CrowMark) if You are a UK SME or public-sector supplier who wants published pricing from £49 per month. You need Contracts Finder and Find a Tender discovery refreshed daily. You want the AI blocked from inventing a figure, with a PPN 017 disclosure on every draft. You need deterministic PPN 002 social value maths and post-award delivery evidence. Where CrowMark loses honestly A balanced comparison has to concede the gaps. AutogenAI is a larger, better-funded company with a longer track record and an engine built for high-volume, multi-sector enterprise bidding. If you need that breadth, dedicated account management at enterprise scale, or a content engine tuned across many industries, AutogenAI is the more established option, and CrowMark, as a newer SME product, is not trying to be that. CrowMark is deliberately narrow: UK public-sector suppliers, grounded answers, social value and delivery evidence. The two are not mutually exclusive; some teams run an enterprise engine for the largest proposals and CrowMark for UK tender discovery, social-value scoring and post-award evidence. Can either tool stop the AI inventing figures? Is AutogenAI a bigger company than CrowAgent? Does either cover PPN 002 social value maths? Can I use both CrowMark and AutogenAI?
